description: This file defines the ITransactionalResource interface, which specifies methods for transaction participants in Orleans transactions, including commit, prepare, abort, cancel, and confirm operations.

classes.name: ITransactionalResource
classes.description: Interface for transaction participants in Orleans, defining methods for commit, prepare, abort, cancel, and confirm operations.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Handles read-only transaction commit requests from the transaction agent.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Handles prepare messages from the transaction agent to participants.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Handles abort messages indicating a transaction has been aborted.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Handles cancel messages indicating a transaction has been aborted with a reason.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Handles confirmation messages indicating a transaction has been committed.
